title: Honey has its own /themes page, share cards and coaching Spotlight copy

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-19: "Make Sure Mindless and Honey have their full theme kit with all designs. List Honey in the themes, so we have 10."

detail: Honey (id free-human) was offered in the pickers (LIVE-2358) but its manifest pointed at /themes/free-human, a page that did not exist, and it had no theme page pictures and no link preview card. This row adds the Honey feature page on the shared FrequencyThemeFeature layout (a THEME_FEATURES entry with its lead, signature parts, made-for list and FAQ, the five Honey starter kits), puts it in the sitemap, draws its four page pictures (website, Spotlight, Space desk, welcome email) with the real Honey skin, faces and Frequency photos, and adds share cards for Honey and Mindless (Mindless on its pink photo, per the share-card colour rule). The Honey Spotlight defaults now coach the owner what to write instead of carrying Free Human Movement's own words.
